prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (RDC, call sign Juniper) intakes EMS requests and preserves incident record (original report, clarifications/estimates, location/medical details, priority, assignments, route/destination/arrival/handover changes). Aliases: Call Taker Mara=Larkspur; Triage Supervisor=Copperfield; Shift Commander=Sundial; Radio Coordinator=Mistral. Jurisdictions retain resource ownership/local policy; zones/routes reviewed for road/population/agreement changes. Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) decisions consider distance, access, travel time, restrictions/weather/closures, queues/demand/capacity, crew readiness, unit capability, coverage. Larkspur enters/updates data, confirms incident ID/intended receiving facility before destination request, uses Caller Location Correction Slip/correction slip, receives Bedside Arrival Receipt, verifies arrival time vs dispatch timeline/crew comms. Copperfield assigns/confirms priority/basis/response level, sends Pediatric Acuity Note, validates surge declaration/prioritization, advises repositioning. Pediatric calls with concerning airway/breathing/circulation/mental-status findings get prompt clinical escalation; Hospital Liaison Desk uses Pediatric Acuity Note for receiving staff. Regional Medical Director sets clinical policy/priorities/guidance/limits, gives demand-exceeds-routine/regional-protocol direction; no operational dispatch authority. Ambulance Coordination Platform consolidates position/status, matching units, time-stamped status changes, approved destination/instructions; RDC uses swap voucher for battery readiness and queue snapshot before northern routing. Computer Aided Dispatch Console displays surge level/field-facility constraints. Mistral manages radio/talkgroups and via Regional Radio Network sends incident/destination/route updates/hazards, Coverage Gap Bulletin, retries no-ack; Paramedic Crew acknowledges/repeats destination/location/priority, reports status/position/route issues, requests renewed consultation if needed. Ambulance Unit 417 reports facility arrival and handover complete; RDC updates incident status after transfer to facility care. North/South Gate Status Boards display queue/access; South Gate Status Board produces South Access Lane Notice for material south constraint. Sundial reviews coverage/access constraints, approves exceptions/nonstandard response, assigns surge coordination, escalates unresolved destination/access issues, sends Mutual Aid Release Form. Hospital Liaison Desk coordinates facility capacity/destination consultation/acceptance and handover questions. Emergency Department reports limits/constraints/status and with crew resolves identity/document discrepancies before clear. Data Quality Officer reviews inconsistent/incomplete

New part:
S181: Call Taker Mara obtains the age, weight when available, and caregiver observations needed to support pediatric triage.
S182: Paramedic Crew reassesses pediatric patients during transport and reports material changes to the receiving facility.
S183: Kestrel shall confirm that facility capacity and pediatric service limitations are communicated to dispatch before a destination is finalized.
S184: Riverside Trauma Center advises Hospital Liaison Desk when trauma intake conditions may affect the suitability of an otherwise appropriate destination.
S185: Emergency Department staff acknowledge destination changes through the established coordination channel and identify any immediate access restrictions.
S186: Hospital Liaison Desk records facility responses in the regional coordination record and keeps dispatch informed of unresolved constraints.
S187: Mutual aid is requested when local staffed units cannot meet the declared response objectives or when a specialized resource is unavailable.
S188: Regional Radio Network carries mutual-aid requests, acceptance confirmations, and operational updates using the agreed regional call signs.
S189: Copperfield shall approve any temporary triage override and document its rationale before the override is applied.
S190: Ambulance Coordination Platform tracks accepted mutual-aid assignments separately from locally staffed resources to preserve an accurate coverage view.
S191: Ambulance Unit 417 may be reassigned only after dispatch confirms that its current patient-care and transport obligations permit the change.
S192: Fleet Maintenance Cell reports a vehicle restriction promptly so dispatch does not count an unavailable unit toward operational coverage.
S193: Triage Supervisor reviews the audit memo before closing a suspected duplicate incident.
S194: Data Quality Officer reviews unresolved record discrepancies through the established quality process without delaying active patient care.
S195: North Gate Status Board provides a current view of access conditions that may affect ambulance approach or handover timing.
S196: South Gate Status Board provides the equivalent access view for routes and entry points on the southern side of the region.
S197: After surge conditions ease, Shift Commander confirms that outstanding assignments, destination constraints, and staffing gaps have been handed over to the next operational period.
S198: Regional Dispatch Center maintains a degraded-radio procedure that prioritizes emergency traffic and preserves a common operating picture.
S199: Regional Radio Network operators announce channel outages, affected areas, and expected restoration times over the remaining service channels.
S200: Radio Coordinator directs crews to approved fallback channels when the primary channel is unusable.
S201: Crews acknowledge each fallback assignment and repeat critical location and destination details before moving.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
